he.t: אין חנון בכל מקום אלא לשון מתנת חנם, אע"פ שיש להם לצדיקים לתלות במעשיהם הטובים, אין מבקשים מאת המקום אלא מתנת חנם, לפי שאמר לו וְחַנֹּתִי אֶת אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן (שמות לג, יט), אמר לו בלשון ואתחנן. דבר אחר, זה אחד מעשרה לשונות שנקראת תפלה, כדאיתא בספרי (כו):

en.t: I pleaded.

The word חִנוּן everywhere signifies an undeserved gift. Although the righteous might claim [reward] based on their good deeds, they ask the Almighty only for an undeserved gift. Because [the Almighty] had said to him, “I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious,” he [Moshe] uses the expression וְאֶתְחַנַּן . There is another explanation: This is one of the ten terms by which prayer is described, as is stated in Sifrei.

he.t: לאחר שכבשתי ארץ סיחון ועוג דִּמִיתִי שמא הותר הנדר (ספרי שם):

en.t: At that time.
After I had captured the land of Sichon and Og, I imagined that the vow had been cancelled.

he.t: זה אחד משלשה מקומות שאמר משה לפני המקום, איני מניחך עד שתודיעני אם תעשה שאלתי אם לאו:

en.t: Saying.
This is one of the three occasions where Moshe said to the Almighty, “I will not leave You alone until You make known to me whether You will do as I requested or not.”
Adonoy, Elohim.
Merciful in judgement.

he.t: פתח להיות עומד ומתפלל אע"פ שנגזרה גזירה, אמר לו ממך למדתי, שאמרת לי וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי (שמות לב, י), וכי תופס הייתי בך, אלא לפתוח פתח שבי היה תלוי להתפלל עליהם (ספרי כז), כמו כן הייתי סבור לעשות עכשיו:

en.t: You have begun to show Your servant

an opportunity to stand and pray even though the decree has gone forth. He [Moshe] said to Him, “I learned this from you, for You said to me, ‘Now leave me alone.’ Was I then holding You? [But You said this] to provide an opportunity [and to show] that it was up to me to pray for them. Similarly, I thought to do so now.”

he.t: זו מדת טובך, וכן הוא אומר, וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי (במדבר יד, יז):

en.t: Your Greatness.
This refers to Your attribute of goodness. Similarly it is said, ”And now please magnify the Might of my Master.”

he.t: זו ימינך, שהיא פשוטה לכל באי עולם:

en.t: And Your hand.
This refers to Your right hand which is extended to all who enter the world.

he.t: שאתה כובש ברחמים את מידת הדין החזקה:

en.t: Powerful.
You subdue with [Your] compassion the attribute of strict justice.

he.t: אינך דומה למלך בשר ודם, שיש לו יועצין וְסַנְקַתַּדְּרִין, הממחין בידו כשרוצה לעשות חסד ולעבור על מדותיו, אתה אין מי ימחה בידך אם תמחול לי ותבטל גזירתך. ולפי פשוטו, אתה החלות להראות את עבדך, מלחמת סיחון ועוג, כדכתיב רְאֵה הַחִלֹּתִי תֵּת לְפָנֶיךָ (דברים ב, לא), הראני מלחמת ל"א מלכים:

en.t: That there is no power etc.

You are unlike a king of flesh and blood who has advisors and critics who would deter him when he wants to do kindness and to forgo his attribute [of strict justice]. You, however, there is no one to deter You, should You pardon me and annul Your decree. But according to its simplistic sense [it means]: You have begun to show Your servant the war with Sichon and Og, as it is written, “I have begun defeating before you;” show me also the war with the thirty-one kings.
Please allow me to cross over.
The word נָא denotes a request.
This good mountain.
A reference to Jerusalem.
And the Lebanon.
A reference to the Bais HaMikdosh.
Adonoy grew angry [at me].
He was filled with wrath.

he.t: בשבילכם, אתם גרמתם לי, וכן הוא אומר, וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם (תהלים קו, לב):

en.t: Through your fault.
You caused this [to happen] to me. Similarly it is said, “And they provoked Him at the waters of Merivah, and Moshe suffered harm because of them.”

he.t: שלא יאמרו הרב כמה קשה, והתלמיד כמה סרבן מפציר. דבר אחר רב לך, הרבה מזה שמור לך, רב טוב הצפון לך (ספרי פנחס קלה):

en.t: Enough for you.

So that people should not say, “How harsh is the Master, and how stubborn and pleading is the disciple.” Another explanation of רַב לָךְ . Much more than this is preserved for you, great is the goodness that is hidden away for you. (Siphre)

he.t: בקשת ממני ואראה את הארץ הטובה, אני מראה לך את כולה, שנאמר וַיַּרְאֵהוּ ה' אֶת כָּל הָאָרֶץ (לקמן לד, א):

en.t: And see with your own eyes.
You asked of Me — “And let me see the good land”; I will show you all of it, as it is said, “And Adonoy showed him all the land.”

he.t: על הטרחות ועל המשאות, ועל המריבות:

en.t: And command Yehoshua.
Regarding the troubles, the burdens and the strifes [of leadership.]

he.t: בדבריך, שלא ירך לבו לומר, כשם שנענש רבי עליהם כך סופי ליענש עליהם, מבטיחו אני, כי הוא יעבור והוא ינחיל:

en.t: And encourage him and embolden him.

With your words so that he will not become faint-hearted, saying, “Just as my teacher (Moshe) was punished because of them, so eventually will I be punished because of them”; I [therefore] assure him that he will cross over and he shall apportion to them [the land.]

he.t: אם יעבור לפניהם ינחלו, ואם לאו לא ינחלו. וכן אתה מוצא כששלח מן העם אל העי, והוא יָשַׁב, וַיַּכּוּ מֵהֶם אַנְשֵׁי הָעַי וגו' (יהושע ז, ה), וכיון שנפל על פניו, אמר לו קֻם לָךְ (שם פסוק י), קם לך כתיב, אתה הוא העומד במקומך ומשלח את בני למלחמה, למה זה אתה נופל על פניך, לא כך אמרתי למשה רבך, אם הוא עובר עוברין ואם לאו אין עוברין:

en.t: Because he will cross.

If he will cross at the head [of this people] they will possess [the land], but if not they will not possess it. And similarly you find that when he sent some of the people against Ai and he remained [in the camp], “The men of Ai killed [thirty-six] of them.” And when he fell on his face, he [God] said to him, “Get up.” It [the word קֻם ] is written [without the vov] [so that it can be read] קָם לָךְ — [It is because of] you remaining in your place and sending My children to war [that caused this defeat.] Why is it that you have fallen on your face? Did I not say this to Moshe, your teacher: If he will cross over [at the head] they will cross, and if not, they will not cross.

he.t: ונצמדתם לעבודת אלילים, ואעפ"כ ועתה ישראל שמע אל החקים, והכל מחול לך, ואני לא זכיתי לימחל לי (ספרי פנחס קלו):

en.t: We lived in the valley [facing Beis Peor].
And you attached yourselves to idolatry, but nevertheless, “And now Yisroel, listen to the statutes,” and everything is forgiven you. But I was not privileged to be forgiven.

he.t: כגון חמש פרשיות בתפילין, חמשת מינין בלולב, וחמש ציציות, וכן לא תגרעו (ספרי ראה פב):

en.t: Do not add.

For instance to place five parshiyos in the tefillin, to take five species [of fruit] for the mitzvah of lulav, to place five fringes [instead of four on one’s garment]; and this also applies to (the command), “And do not subtract from them.”
You will preserve them.
This refers to the study of the Mishnah.
And you will fulfill them.
As literally implied.

he.t: בזאת תֵּחָשְׁבוּ חכמים ונבונים לעיני העמים:

en.t: For that [displays] your wisdom and understanding, etc.
Through this you will be considered wise and understanding in the eyes of the nations.
Upright statutes and laws.
That are proper and acceptable.

he.t: רק השמר לך וגו' פן תשכח את הדברים.
אז, כשלא תשכחו אותם ותעשום על אמתתם, תחשבו חכמים ונבונים, ואם תְּעַוותוּ אותם מתוך שכחה, תֵּחָשְׁבוּ שוטים:

en.t: [Only] look out for yourself, etc. Lest you forget the words.
Then, if you do not forget them, and you fulfill them correctly will you be considered wise and understanding; but if you distort them through forgetfulness, you will be considered fools.

he.t: מוסב על מקרא שלמעלה ממנו, אשר ראו עיניך, יום אשר עמדת בחורב, אשר ראיתם את הקולות ואת הלפידים:

en.t: The day you stood.
This verse is connected with the preceding verse: “[the words] your eyes witnessed” on the day you stood at Choreiv, where you saw the thunder and lightning.
They will learn.
For themselves [ יֵלְפוּן ].
They will teach.
Others. [ יְאַלְפוּן ].

he.t: ואתי צוה ה' בעת ההיא ללמד אתכם.

en.t: Adonoy commanded me at that time to teach you.
This refers to the Oral Law.
סָמֶל .
Form.

he.t: להסתכל בדבר, ולתת לב לשוב לטעות אחריהם:

en.t: Or lest you raise your eyes [heavenward] —
to speculate about the matter, and to set your heart to blunder after them.

he.t: להאיר להם. דבר אחר, לאלוהות, לא מנען מלטעות אחריהם, אלא החליקם בדברי הבליהם לטרדם מן העולם (ע"ז נה.), וכן הוא אומר, כִּי הֶחֱלִיק אֵלָיו בְּעֵינָיו לִמְצֹא עֲוֹנוֹ לִשְׂנֹא (תהלים לו, ג):

en.t: When Adonoy has made them available

to provide them with light. Another explanation: [He made them available] as deities. He did not prevent them from blundering after them, but paved the way for them [to err] through their meaningless speculations, in order to banish them from the world. Similarly it states: “For he smoothes [the way] before his eyes, causing Him [God] to discover his iniquity for which He will hate him.

he.t: הוא כלי שמזקקים בו את הזהב:

en.t: [Iron] crucible.
This is a vessel in which gold is refined.
Grew angry.
He was filled with wrath.
On account of your statements.
Because of your attitude and your actions.

he.t: כי אנכי מת וגו' אינני עובר.
מאחר שמת מהיכן יעבור, אלא אף עצמותי אינם עוברין:

en.t: For I am to die — I am not crossing.
Since he was to die, how was he to cross? But [what he meant was] “even my bones will not cross over.”
An image of anything.
The likeness of any object.
That Adonoy commanded you.
That He commanded you not to make.

he.t: מקנא לנקום אנפרדמנ"ט בלע"ז (אייפער) מִתְחָרֶה על רוגזו להפרע מעכו"ם:

en.t: A jealous Almighty.
He is jealous to take vengeance; In Old French — emportement. His anger is glowing to punish those who worship idols.

he.t: רמז להם שיגלו ממנה לסוף שמונה מאות וחמשים ושתים שנה, כמנין ונושנתם, והוא הקדים והגלם לסוף שמונה מאות וחמשים, והקדים שתי שנים לונושנתם, כדי שלא יתקיים בהם כי אבד תאבדון, וזהו שנאמר, וַיִּשְׁקֹד ה' עַל הָרָעָה וַיְבִיאֶהָ עָלֵינוּ כִּי צַדִּיק ה' אֱלֹהֵינוּ (דניאל ט, יד), צדקה עשה עמנו, שמהר להביאה ב' שנים לפני זמנה (סנהדרין לח.):

en.t: And have grown old.

He hinted to them that they would be exiled from it at the end of eight hundred and fifty-two years, which is the numerical value [gematria] of וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּם . But he sent them into exile earlier — at the end of eight hundred and fifty years. He exiled them two years earlier than the numerical value of וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּם so they would not suffer the fulfillment of “that you will be completely removed [from the land].” And this is [the meaning of] what is said: “And Adonoy precipitated the evil, and He brought it upon us, for Adonoy our God is righteous.” He acted righteously [charitably צְדָקָה) with us, for He hastened to bring [the evil] two years before its time.

he.t: הנני מזמינם להיות עדים התריתי בכם:

en.t: I bring as witness against you.
I have designated them to be witnesses that I have warned you.

he.t: כתרגומו, משאתם עובדים לעובדיהם, כאילו אתם עובדים להם:

en.t: There you will serve gods.
[This should be understood] as the Targum [has it]: Since you will serve those who worship them [idols] it will be considered as though you worship them [idols].

he.t: מלהחזיק בך בידיו, ולשון לא ירפך לשון לא יפעיל הוא, לא יתן לך רפיון, לא יפריש אותך מאצלו, וכן אֲחַזְתִּיו וְלֹא אַרְפֶּנּוּ (שיר השירים ג, ד), שלא ננקד אֶרְפֶּנּוּ. כל לשון רפיון מוסב על לשון מפעיל ומתפעל, כמו הַרְפֵּה לָהּ (מלכים־ב ד, כז), תן לה רפיון, הֶרֶף מִמֶּנִּי (לקמן ט, יד), הִתְרַפֵּה מִמֶּנִּי:

en.t: He will not forsake you by not supporting you with His hands.

The expression of לֹא יַרְפְּךָ is an expression signifying that He will not cause something — he will not cause you to be weakened [forsaken], for He will not separate you from Him. Similarly, “I grasped him and would not let him go,” the word אַרְפֶּנוּ is not vocalized אֶרְפֶֶּנוּ . The term רִפְיוֹן always refers to the causative or reflexive form — [one who forsakes others or one who causes himself to be forsaken], as for example: ”Leave her alone,” — let her be released. ”Leave Me alone” — release yourself from Me.
The early years.
Regarding the early years.

he.t: וגם שאל לכל הברואים אשר מקצה אל קצה, זהו פשוטו. ומדרשו, מלמד על קומתו של אדם שהיתה מן הארץ עד השמים (חגיגה יב.), והוא השיעור עצמו אשר מקצה אל קצה:

en.t: From one end of the heavens.

Also inquire of all the creatures [that exist] from one end [of heaven] to the other end. This is its plain meaning; but a Midrashic explanation teaches us regarding the height of Adam which reached from earth to heaven, which is the same measurement as from one end [of the heavens] to the other end.

he.t: ומהו הדבר הגדול, השמע עם וגו':

en.t: Did anything ever happen comparable to this great event?
And what is this great event? [See next verses] Did any people [ever hear], etc.

he.t: הֲכִי עשה נסים שום אלוה לבא לקחת לו גוי וגו', כל ההי"ן הללו תמיהות הן, לכך נקודות הן בחט"ף פת"ח, הנהיה, הנשמע, הֲנִסָּה, הֲשָׁמַע:

en.t: Did any god ever miraculously [come].

Has any god ever performed such miracles to come and take for himself a nation, etc. All these letters hei (ה) are interrogative prefixes, and are therefore vocalized with chataph patach: הֲנִהְיָה — Did anything ever happen. הֲנִשְׁמַע — Did anyone ever hear הֲשָׁמַע — Did any people ever hear. הֲנִסָּה — Did any god ever miraculously.

he.t: על ידי נסיונות הודיעם גבורותיו, כגון הִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי (שמות ח, ה), אם אוכל לעשות כן הרי זה נסיון:

en.t: Through tests.
By means of tests, he made His mighty deeds known to them, for example: “Glorify yourself at my expense,” whether I will be able to do so. This is an example of a test.

he.t: בסימנין, להאמין שהוא שלוחו של מקום, כגון מַה זֶה בְיָדֶךָ (שם ד, ב):

en.t: With signs.
With signs to confirm that he [Moshe] is the messenger of the Almighty, for example, “What is that in your hand.”

he.t: הם נפלאות, שהביא עליהם מכות מופלאות:

en.t: With wonders.
These refer to the wonders that He brought upon them — the astonishing plagues.

he.t: בים, שנאמר כִּי ה' נִלְחָם לָהֶם (שם יד, כה):

en.t: Through warfare.
[This refers to the episode] of the [Reed] Sea, as it is said, “For Adonoy is fighting for them.”

he.t: כתרגומו אִתְחֲזֵיתָא, כשנתן הקב"ה את התורה פתח להם שבעה רקיעים, וכשם שקרע את העליונים, כך קרע את התחתונים וראו שהוא יחידי, לכך נאמר אתה הראת לדעת:

en.t: You have been shown.

The word הָרְאֵתָ according to Targum Onkelos means “You were shown.” When the Holy One, blessed is He, gave the Torah, He lay open for them the seven heavens. And just as he split [opened] the upper spheres so too did He split the lower spheres, and thus they saw that He is the only One. It is therefore stated: “You have been shown that you might know.”
Because He loved [your fathers].
And all this was because He loved [your fathers].

he.t: כאדם המנהיג בנו לפניו, שנאמר וַיִּסַּע מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים הַהֹלֵךְ וגו' וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם (שם יד, יט), דבר אחר ויוציאך בפניו, בפני אבותיו, כמו שנאמר נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא (תהלים עח, יב), ואל תתמה על שהזכירם בלשון יחיד, שהרי כתבם בלשון יחיד, ויבחר בזרעו אחריו:

en.t: And He took you out before Him.

Like a man who leads his son before him, as it is said, “the angel of God moved [from its position] when it traveled in front of the Israelite camp, and went behind them.” Another explanation: “And He took you out in His Presence,” in the presence of their fathers, as it is said, “In the presence of their fathers, He did wonders.” Do not be puzzled that it refers to them (the fathers) in the singular for it has [already] written about them in the singular, “And He chose his descendants after him.”

he.t: סרסהו ודרשהו, להוריש מפניך, גוים גדולים ועצומים ממך:

en.t: [Stronger] than you from before you.
Invert [the order of the verse] and then explain it: “to expel from before you nations greater and stronger than you.”
Like this day.
Just like you see this day.

he.t: נתן לב להיות חרד לַדָּבָר שיבדילם, ואף על פי שאינן קולטות עד שיבדלו אותן שבארץ כנען, אמר משה, מצוה שאפשר לקיימה, אקיימנה (מכות י.):

en.t: Then Moshe set aside.

[ יַבְדִיל is the future tense.] He gave thought in his heart to be concerned about the matter to set them [the cities] aside. And although they would not offer asylum until those cities of Canaan were set aside, Moshe said, a mitzvah that I can fulfil, I will fulfil.
Across the Yardein where the sun rises.
On that side which is on the east of Yardein.

he.t: לפי שהוא דבוק נקודה רי"ש בחטף, מזרח של שמש, מקום זריחת השמש:

en.t: Where the sun rises
Because מִזְרָחָה is in the construct state, the letter reish is vocalized with a chataf [sheva], [meaning] the rising of the sun — i.e., the place of the sun’s rising.

he.t: זו שהוא עתיד לסדר אחר פרשה זו:

en.t: And this is the Torah.
This refers to that which he was about to set forth after this chapter.

he.t: הם הם אשר דבר בצאתם ממצרים, חזר ושנאה להם בערבות מואב:

en.t: These are the testimonies . . . that Moshe addressed.
They are the very same [testimonies etc.] that he spoke when they went out of Egypt. He reviewed and taught it to them on the plains of Moav.

he.t: שהוא במזרח, שהעבר השני היה במערב:

en.t: Who were across the Yardein.
That is on the east, because the second side was to the west.

he.t: בלבד כרת ה' וגו', כי אתנו:

en.t: Not with our fathers
alone did Adonoy make this covenant, etc., but with us, etc..

he.t: אמר רבי ברכיה, כך אמר משה, אל תאמרו אני מטעה אתכם על לא דבר, כדרך שהסרסור עושה בין המוכר ללוקח, הרי המוכר עצמו מדבר עמכם:

en.t: Face to face.

R’ Berachia said, “This is what Moshe said [implied], Do not say that I am misleading you about something that is not a matter of fact such as an agent does acting as a middleman between the buyer and seller; for in this case, the seller himself is speaking to you.

he.t: מוסב על דבר ה' עמכם בהר מתוך האש לאמר אנכי ה' וגו' ואנכי עומד בין ה' וביניכם:

en.t: Saying.
[The word לֵאמֹר ] is connected [with the previous verse]: Adonoy spoke to you at the mountain from within the fire saying I am Adonoy etc.”; while I was standing between Adonoy and you.

he.t: בכל מקום אשר אני שם, וזהו כל העולם. דבר אחר, כל זמן שאני קיים. עשרת הדברות כבר פרשתים:

en.t: In My presence.
In any place where I am and that includes the entire world. Another explanation: So long as I exist. I have already explained the Ten Commandments.

he.t: ובראשונות הוא אומר זכור, שניהם בדבור אחד ובתיבה אחת נאמרו, ובשמיעה אחת נשמעו (מכילתא בחדש פ"ז):

en.t: Preserve.
In the previous [Ten Commandments] it states “remember.” [the explanation is] both of them (שָׁמוֹר וְזָכוֹר) were pronounced simultaneously and as one word, and were heard in one sound.
As . . . commanded you.
Before the giving of the Torah [you were commanded to do so] at Marah.

he.t: על מנת כן פדאך, שתהיה לו עבד ותשמור מצותיו:

en.t: Remember that you were a slave, etc.
He freed you on the condition that you shall be His servant and preserve His commandments.

he.t: אף על כיבוד אב ואם נצטוו במרה (סנהדרין נו:), שנאמר שָׁם שָׂם לוֹ חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט (שמות טו, כה):

en.t: As the way . . . commanded you.
Also regarding the honor of father and mother were they commanded at Marah, as it is said, “there He set before them a statute and an ordinance.”

he.t: אין לשון ניאוף אלא באשת איש:

en.t: Do not commit adultery.
The term נִאוּף, adultery, is applicable only in reference to a married woman.

he.t: לא תֵירוֹג, אף הוא לשון חמדה, כמו נֶחְמָד לְמַרְאֶה (בראשית ב, ט), דמתרגמינן דִּמְרַגֵּג לְמֶחֱזֵי:

en.t: Do not covet.

[“ לָא תִתְאִַבֶה “ is translated by Targum Onkeles] — “ לֹא תֵירוֹג “ which is also an expression of desiring, similar to נֶחְמָד לְמַרְאֶה (pleasant to look at), which the Targum translates דִּמְרַגַּג לְמֶחֱזֵי (desirable to behold.)

he.t: מתרגמינן ולא פסק, [לפי שמדת בשר ודם אינו יכול לדבר כל דבריו בנשימה אחת, וצריך להפסיק, ומדת הקב"ה אינו כן, לא היה פוסק, ומשלא היה פוסק לא היה מוסיף, כי קולו חזק וקיים לעולם. דבר אחר ולא יסף, ולא הוסיף לְהֵרָאוֹת באותו פומבי:

en.t: Without cessation.

The Targum translates וְלֹא יָסָף, — וְלָא פְסַק without interruption, (Because it is the nature of a human being that he is incapable of speaking all his words in one breath [and therefore he must pause between words]; and it is characteristic of the Holy One, blessed is He, that this is not so, [Therefore] He did not pause, and since He did not pause, there was no need to resume,) because His voice is strong and eternal. Another explanation of וְלֹא יָסָף : He never again revealed Himself in such a public demonstration.

he.t: הִתַּשְׁתֶּם את כחי כנקבה, שנצטערתי עליכם ורפיתם את ידי, כי ראיתי שאינכם חרדים להתקרב אליו מאהבה, וכי לא היה יפה לכם ללמוד מפי הגבורה, ולא ללמוד ממני:

en.t: And you will tell us.

You have diminished my strength like that of a woman, for I was distressed about you and you weakened my hands, because I saw you were not anxious to come near to Him out of love. Would it not have been better for you to learn [directly] from the Mighty One, and not to learn from me.

he.t: ה' שהוא אלהינו עתה, ולא אלהי האומות עובדי אלילים, הוא עתיד להיות ה' אחד, שנאמר כִּי אָז אֶהְפֹּךְ אֶל עַמִּים שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה לִקְרֹא כֻלָּם בְּשֵׁם ה' (צפניה ג, ט), ונאמר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה ה' אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד (זכריה יד, ט):

en.t: Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is one.

Adonoy who is presently our God and not the God of the nations, will in the future be [recognized] as the One God, as is said, “For then I will turn over to the peoples a pure language that they may all call upon the Name of Adonoy.” And it is said, “On that day Adonoy will be One and His name One.”

he.t: עֲשֵׂה דבריו מאהבה, אינו דומה עושה מאהבה לעושה מיראה, העושה אצל רבו מיראה, כשהוא מטריח עליו, מניחו והולך לו (ספרי לב):

en.t: You are to love.

You are to obey His words (commands) because of your love [for Him]. There is no comparison between one who obeys out of love and one who obeys out of fear. He who obeys (serves) his master out of fear, should the master over burden him, he will leave him and go away.

he.t: בשני יצריך. דבר אחר בכל לבבך, שלא יהיה לבך חלוק על המקום (ספרי שם):

en.t: With all your heart.
With your two inclinations. Another interpretation, “with all your heart” — your heart should not be fragmented with God.
With all your soul.
Even if He were to take your soul.

he.t: בכל ממונך, יש לך אדם שממונו חביב עליו מגופו, לכך נאמר ובכל מאדך (ברכות סא:). דבר אחר ובכל מאדך, בכל מדה ומדה שמודד לך, בין במדה טובה בין במדת פורענות, וכן בדוד הוא אומר, כּוֹס יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וגו' (תהלים קטז, יג) צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא וגו' (שם ג):

en.t: And with all your possesions.

With all your wealth. There are men whose wealth is dearer to them than their bodies. It is therefore said, “With all your possessions.” Another interpretation, “With what ever measure” — with what ever measure He apportions you, whether it is a measure of goodness or a measure of punishment (you must love Him). Similarly did Dovid say: “the cup of deliverance I will raise [and upon the Name, Adonoy, I will call]. “Trouble and sorrow I encounter, [and upon the Name, Adonoy, I call].”

he.t: ומהו האהבה, והיו הדברים האלה, שמתוך כך אתה מכיר בהקב"ה ומדבק בדרכיו (ספרי לג):

en.t: And these words.
What is the form of love [you are commanded]? “These words [that I command you today, etc.]” For in this manner you be aware of the Holy One blessed is He, and You will cling to His ways.

he.t: לא יהיו בעיניך כִּדְיוֹטְגְּמָא ישנה שאין אדם סוֹפְנָה, אלא כחדשה שהכל רצין לקראתה (ספרי שם). דְּיוֹטְגְּמָא מצות המלך הבאה במכתב:

en.t: That I command you today.

[These words] shall not be in your eyes like an outdated decree which no one takes seriously, but rather like a newly given one, which is read eagerly by all. [The word] דְיוֹטַגְמָא [implies] a royal command in written form.

he.t: לשון חדוד הוא, שיהיו מחודדים בפיך, שאם ישאלך אדם דבר, לא תהא צריך לגמגם בו, אלא אמור לו מיד (ספרי לד. — קידושין ל.):

en.t: And you shall teach them.

The word שִׁנַנְתָּם is an expression of sharpness, implying that they (words of Torah) should be sharp in your mouth, so that if a person asks you anything about them, you will not need to stammer (hesitate) about it, but tell him (the answer) immediately.

he.t: אלו התלמידים, מצינו בכל מקום שהתלמידים קרוים בנים, שנאמר בָּנִים אַתֶּם לַה' אֱלֹהֵיכֶם (לקמן יד, א), ואומר בְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר בֵּית אֵל (מלכים־ב ב, יג), וכן בחזקיהו שלמד תורה לכל ישראל וקראם בנים, שנאמר בָּנַי עַתָּה אַל תִּשָּׁלוּ (דברי הימים־ב כט, יא), וכשם שהתלמידים קרוים בנים, שנאמר בנים אתם לה' אלהיכם, כך הרב קרוי אב, שנאמר אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וגו' (מלכים־ב ב, יב):

en.t: To your children.

[In this instance בָנֶיךָ ] refers to the disciples (students). We find everywhere that disciples are referred to as children, as it is said, “You are children of Adonoy, your God,” and it says, “the children (disciples) of the prophets who were in Beis Eil.” Similarly in reference to King Chizkiyahu who taught the Torah to all of Yisroel, and he called them children, as it is said, “My children, now, do not be carelessely forgetful.” And even as disciples are called children as it is said, “You are children of Adonoy, your God, so too is the Rav (teacher) called father, as it is said, “My father, my father, the chariot of Yisroel, etc.”

he.t: שלא יהא עיקר דבורך אלא בם, עֲשֵׂם עיקר ואל תַּעֲשֵׂם טפל (ספרי לד):

en.t: And you are to discuss them.
Your main discussions should be only about them. Make them (words of Torah) primary and do not make them of secondary importance.

he.t: יכול אפילו שכב בחצי היום, תלמוד לומר ובקומך, יכול אפילו עמד בחצי הלילה, תלמוד לומר בשבתך בביתך ובלכתך בדרך, דרך ארץ דברה תורה (ספרי שם), זמן שכיבה וזמן קימה:

en.t: When you go to sleep.

I might conclude that this means even if you go to sleep in midday, it is therefore stated, “When you arise.” I might then conclude that this means even if you arise in midnight, it is therefore stated, “When you sit at home and when you walk on the road”; thus the Torah speaks of the usual way of life, [indicating that בְּשָׁכְבְךָ means] the usual time of sleeping [and בְקוּמֶךָ means] the usual time of rising.
And you are to tie them as a sign upon your arm.
These are the tefillin that are placed on the arm.

he.t: אלו תפילין שבראש, ועל שם מנין פרשיותיהם נקראו טטפת, טט בכתפי שתים, פת באפריקי שתים (סנהדרין ד:):

en.t: And they are to be totafos between your eyes.

These are the tefillin that are placed on the head. It is due to the number of Scriptural sections [contained in them] that they are called totafos, for טֹט in Coptic language means two, and פֹת in the African language means two.

he.t: מזזת כתיב, שאין צריך אלא אחת:

en.t: The doorposts of your house.
The word מְזֻזוֹת is written defectively to indicate that only one is necessary [for each door.]

he.t: לרבות שערי חצרות ושערי מדינות ושערי עיירות (יומא יא.):

en.t: And on your gateposts.
[The plural is used] to include the gates of courtyards, the gates of provinces and the gates of cities.

he.t: לפי שהיו מקום טרשין וסלעים, נופל בו לשון חציבה:

en.t: Hewn cisterns.
since it [Eretz Yisroel] is a place of stones and cliffs, the word חַצִיבָה, hewn, is an appropriate term here.

he.t: כתרגומו מבית עבדותא, ממקום שהייתם שם עבדים:

en.t: From the house of slavery.
As the Targum explains: “From the house of slavery,” from the place where you were slaves.

he.t: אם יש בך כל המדות הללו, שאתה ירא את שמו ועובד אותו, אז בשמו תשבע, שמתוך שאתה ירא את שמו תהא זהיר בשבועתך, ואם לאו לא תשבע:

en.t: And swear by His Name.

If you possess all these qualities: You fear His Name and you serve Him, then you may swear by His Name; for since you fear His Name you will be prudent with your oath, otherwise you should not swear.

he.t: והוא הדין לרחוקים, אלא לפי שאתה רואה את סביבותיך תועים אחריהם, הוצרך להזהיר עליהם ביותר:

en.t: From the gods of the peoples around you.
This laws also applies to those that are far away, but since you observe how those around you go astray after them, the need to warn you against them was of greater necessity.

he.t: כשיצאו ממצרים שנסוהו במים, שנאמר הֲיֵשׁ ה' בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ (שמות יז, ז):

en.t: At Massoh.
When they went out of Egypt, it was there that they tested Him regarding water, as it is said, “Is Adonoy among us (or not).”
The upright and the good.
This refers to compromises beyond what is outlined by the law.

he.t: והיכן דבר, וְהַמֹּתִי אֶת כָּל הָעָם וגו' (שמות כג, כז):

en.t: As (Adonoy) declared.
And where did He so declare? “And I will bring panic to all the people, etc.”
When your son asks you tomorrow.
The word מָחָר (tomorrow) is used sometimes in reference to a distant future.

he.t: לשון השלכה והתזה, וכן וְנָשַׁל הַבַּרְזֶל (לקמן יט, ה):

en.t: And He will cast out.
This is an expression of casting away and displacing, and similarly, “And the iron flies off.”

he.t: לא תתן להם חן, אסור לו לאדם לומר כמה נאה כותי זה. דבר אחר, לא תתן להם חנייה בארץ (עבודה זרה כ.):

en.t: And do not favor them.
Do not hold them in esteem. It is forbidden to say, “How handsome is the heathen.” Another interpretation: do not give them an encampment (settlement) in the land.

he.t: בנו של כותי כשישא את בתך, יסיר את בנך אשר תלד לו בתך מאחרי, למדנו שבן בתך הבא מן הכותי קרוי בנך, אבל בן בנך הבא מן הכותית, אינו קרוי בנך אלא בנה, שהרי לא נאמר על בתו, לא תקח כי תסיר את בנך מאחרי, אלא כי יסיר את בנך וגו' (קידושין סח:):

en.t: For he will turn your son away from me.

If the son of the gentile will marry your daughter, he will turn away your son (grandson) whom your daughter will bear for him, from following after Me. From this we learn that your daughter’s son, who is born of a gentile, is considered your son; but your son’s son, born of a gentile woman, is not considered your son, rather her son; for it is not said [regarding the prohibition:] “Do not take his daughter for your son,” because she will turn [your (grand)son away from Me], but only that he (the gentile) will turn your son, etc.
Their altars.
Constructed of several stones.
Their monuments.
Made of a single stone.
Their worship-trees.
Trees which they worship.
Their statues.
Carved images.

he.t: כפשוטו. ומדרשו, לפי שאין אתם מגדילים עצמכם כשאני משפיע לכם טובה, לפיכך חשקתי בכם (חולין פט.):

en.t: Not because of the multitude of your population.
This is to be taken literally, but there is also a Midrashic interpretation: Because you do not magnify yourselves (boasting) when I shower you with goodness, therefore did [Adonoy] delight in you.

he.t: הממעטין עצמכם, כגון אברהם שאמר וְאָנֹכִי עָפָר וָאֵפֶר (בראשית יח, כז), וכגון משה ואהרן שאמרו וְנַחְנוּ מָה (שמות טז, ז), לא כנבוכדנצר שאמר אֶדַּמֶּה לְעֶלְיוֹן (ישעיה יד, יד), וסנחריב שאמר מִי בְּכָל אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת (שם לו, כ), וחירם שאמר אָנִי מוֹשַׁב אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁבְתִּי (יחזקאל כח, ב):

en.t: For you are the least.

You diminish yourselves, as did Avrohom, who said, “I am but dust and ashes,” and like Moshe and Aharon who said, “What are we”? And you are not as Nevuchadnetzar, who said, “I will be compared to the Most High,” or like like Sancherev, who said, “Who are they among all the gods of these lands, [that have delivered their land out of my hand that Adonoy should deliver Jerusalem and of my hand”?] or like Chirom, who said, “I am a god, in the seat of God, I sit.”
For you are the least.
Here the word כִּי is used to express “for.”

he.t: הרי כי משמש בלשון אלא, לא מרובכם חשק ה' בכם אלא מאהבת ה' אתכם:

en.t: Rather, out of Adonoy’s love. Here the word כִּי is used to express “rather.” “Not because of the multitude of your population, did Adonoy desire you, rather, out of Adonoy’s love for you.”
And out of His keeping the oath.
On account of His keeping the oath.

he.t: ולהלן הוא אומר לַאֲלָפִים (לעיל ה, י), כאן שהוא סמוך אצל לשומרי מצותיו העושין מיראה, הוא אומר לאלף, ולהלן שהוא סמוך אצל לאוהביו העושין מאהבה, ששכרם יותר גדול, הוא אומר לאלפים (סוטה לא.):

en.t: For a thousand generations.

But below it states: “For thousands of generations.” Here where it is connected to “and for those who keep His commandments” [referring to those who do so out of fear] it states “for a thousand generations; but below it is connected to “for those who love Me” [referring to those who do so out of love, whose reward is greater,] it states for thousands of generations.
For those who love Him.
They obey [God’s commandments] out of love.
And for those who keep His commandments.
Referring to those who do so out of fear.

he.t: בחייו משלם לו גמולו הטוב, כדי להאבידו מן העולם הבא:

en.t: And He pays His enemy to his face.
During his lifetime He rewards him for his good deeds, in order to destroy him [from participating] in the World to Come.
Today, to fulfill.
And tomorrow in the World to Come, [will you] receive the reward for them.
